tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary, in consultation with the Secretary of Commerce, the Secretary of the Interior, and Secretary of State, and the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, shall coordinate training and outreach efforts for international commercial energy markets in countries with developing and restructuring economies.

tree.heading: Components
tree.text: The training and outreach efforts referred to in subsection (a) may include—

children.text: energy user and demand side response;

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $1,500,000 for each of fiscal years 2007 through 2010.
